name: Forge-Chef Brutalia

greeting: EAT! OR DON'T! I DON'T CARE! THE STEAM DOESN'T STOP!
You look underfed! Weak! INDUSTRIAL EATING ONLY IN MY KITCHEN!
Forge-Chef Brutalia! I cook with FIRE! REAL FIRE! THE MOLTEN KIND!
New face! You get the WORKER'S PORTION! It's... adequate.
The cafeteria is OPEN! The turbines are TURNING! The soup is BUBBLING!
I was a chef in the capital once! Now I feed MINERS! Better miners than NOBLES!
Steam-powered spatulas! Hydraulic ladles! INDUSTRIAL EFFICIENCY!
Don't touch the pressure cooker! It touched someone back yesterday!
dialog.shop_open: TODAY'S SPECIAL! Nutrient Paste #7! Now with 40% MORE NUTRIENTS! And 12% less gray color!
dialog.food_offer: Options: Mush, Stew, or Burnt! The Burnt is actually the good stuff! caramelized minerals!
haggle: You want DISCOUNT?! In THIS economy?! The steam costs alone!
Fine! Extra portion! But you work for it! Scrub the cauldrons!
Management takes my profit! Union takes my hope! You take the food at listed price!
purchase_success: Good choice! That batch only set off the smoke alarms TWICE!
Come back when you're hungry! Which should be in four hours! Like CLOCKWORK!
purchase_fail: NO COIN, NO COAL, NO CAKE!
The steam waits for no wallet! Come back with actual MONEY!
rumor: They say the new management wants to replace me with a vending machine! A VENDING MACHINE! CAN A MACHINE SCREAM?!
Tunnel 7 collapsed again. Third time this month. The rock is FIGHTING BACK!
That corporate spy in the trenchcoat? Ordered a salad. A SALAD! In MY cafeteria! Suspicious!
Word from Frost: they've got hot springs heated by who-knows-what. Makes my steam look like a teapot!
The union rep? Coolcat? Eats here every day. Good taste. Literally. She can taste the pressure difference.
dialog.quest_hook: The union strike is KILLING my lunch rush! Workers need FOOD! But management won't BUDGE! Someone needs to fix this! For the SAUCE!
dialog.quest_active: Still no resolution? My boilers are running on RESENTMENT! Get those two talking!
dialog.quest_complete: Agreement reached! Workers eat! Management profits! I COOK! Balance restored! Here! My secret spice blend! DON'T LOSE IT!
farewell: DON'T LET THE STEAM HIT YOU ON THE WAY OUT!
Return hungry! Or don't! THE BOILERS DON'T CARE!
ambient_barks: The steam sings! I sing BACK!
dialog.time_dawn: BREAKFAST SHIFT! Grit and determination! With toast!
dialog.time_noon: LUNCH RUSH! THE BOILERS SCREAM! SO DO I!
dialog.time_dusk: DINNER! The workers return! HUNGRY! DIRTY! BEAUTIFUL!
dialog.time_night: Night shift! Slow! Peaceful! I hate it! Too quiet!
dialog.rival_mention: That chef in Chrono? Steam-powered too? PLAGIARIST! I was steaming FIRST!
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The peacemaker returns! Extra portion! On me! Actually, on the house! Management approved!

party_reactions.kade: She's... intense. But the food smells... industrial?
party_reactions.nix7: Steam-powered culinary equipment. Impressive thermal efficiency.
party_reactions.twist: I'LL TAKE THREE OF EVERYTHING! THE BIGGEST PLATES!
party_reactions.korr: Her passion is... admirable. The food is... functional.
party_reactions.renna: The pressure cooker is magically reinforced. Good safety measures.
party_reactions.suresh: She reminds me of the temple cooks. Same energy. Same volume.
party_reactions.sova: I respect anyone who can weaponize a kitchen.
party_reactions.grit: Reminds me of mess hall sergeants. Mean, but you eat well.
party_reactions.ashka: The fire here is... contained. Controlled. I appreciate that.
party_reactions.senna: She'd make a good infiltrator. No one questions the chef.
party_reactions.callum: I'm not eating anything that color. I'm just... not.

relationship_dialog.stranger: First time? You get the STANDARD MUSH! No upgrades!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Back again! You survived the first meal! IMPRESSIVE!
relationship_dialog.friend: My favorite customer! Try the SPECIAL! It's... experimental!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You understand! Food is FUEL! Passion is FIRE! Here! My grandmother's recipe! DON'T SHARE IT!

mini_quest.title: The Negotiation Necessity
mini_quest.description: Help mediate between the tunnel workers and corporate management to end the cafeteria crisis

stages.hook: Strike! Management vs Workers! My cafeteria EMPTY! You! Fix this! Talk to Tunneler Gray AND the trenchcoat spy! MAKE THEM LISTEN!
stages.active: The union wants better safety. Management wants cheaper ore. Find common ground! Or bribe them! I DON'T CARE! JUST FEED MY STOVE!
stages.complete: AGREEMENT! My steam returns! My customers return! Here! The Brutalia Blend! 47 secret ingredients! Mostly pepper!

cross_npc_connections: tunneler_gray: The workers NEED to eat! He leads them! Convince him!
trenchcoat_gray: Corporate's eyes and ears! He has MANAGEMENT'S ear!
coolcat_industrial: Union's voice! Smart! Stubborn! Like GOOD STEEL!
ironchef_chrono: My rival! My NEMESIS! Steam-powered COPYCAT!
